questions.explanation: The given values show that <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.05ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2.74ex" height="1.645ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -705 1211 727" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(760,0)"><use data-c="1D45F" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D45F"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> has maximum oxidation potential, therefore its oxidation will be easiest.
